question: For a bank database with customer transactions, calculate each customer's daily running balance (where deposits add to the balance and other transaction types subtract). For each customer and each day, compute the 30-day rolling average balance (only after having 30 days of data, and treating negative averages as zero). Then group these daily averages by month and find each customer's maximum 30-day average balance within each month. Sum these maximum values across all customers for each month. Consider the first month of each customer's transaction history as the baseline period and exclude it from the final results, presenting monthly totals of these summed maximum 30-day average balances.
sql:
-- Full solution
WITH daily_net AS (
  SELECT customer_id, txn_date, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) as daily_net
  FROM customer_transactions 
  GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),
customer_dates AS (
  SELECT customer_id, MIN(CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) as min_date, MAX(CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) as max_date
  FROM daily_net
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
all_dates AS (
  SELECT customer_id, min_date, max_date,
    CAST(min_date + CAST(seq.n AS INTEGER) AS DATE) as txn_date
  FROM customer_dates,
    LATERAL (SELECT unnest(generate_series(0, 100)) as n) AS seq
  WHERE CAST(min_date + CAST(seq.n AS INTEGER) AS DATE) <= max_date
),
with_balance AS (
  SELECT ad.customer_id, ad.txn_date, ad.min_date,
    COALESCE(dn.daily_net, 0) as daily_net,
    SUM(COALESCE(dn.daily_net, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY ad.customer_id ORDER BY ad.txn_date) as running_balance,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ad.customer_id ORDER BY ad.txn_date) as day_seq
  FROM all_dates ad
  LEFT JOIN daily_net dn ON ad.customer_id = dn.customer_id AND ad.txn_date = CAST(dn.txn_date AS DATE)
),
with_rolling AS (
  SELECT customer_id, txn_date, min_date, running_balance, day_seq,
    AVG(running_balance) OVER (
      PARTITION BY customer_id 
      ORDER BY txn_date 
      ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) as rolling_avg_30d
  FROM with_balance
),
-- Only after 30 days of data
with_filtered AS (
  SELECT customer_id, txn_date, rolling_avg_30d, day_seq
  FROM with_rolling
  WHERE day_seq >= 30
),
-- Treat negative averages as zero
with_clamped AS (
  SELECT customer_id, txn_date, 
    CASE WHEN rolling_avg_30d < 0 THEN 0 ELSE rolling_avg_30d END as clamped_avg
  FROM with_filtered
),
-- Extract month
with_monthly AS (
  SELECT customer_id, txn_date, clamped_avg,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', txn_date) as month_start
  FROM with_clamped
),
-- First month per customer
first_months AS (
  SELECT customer_id, MIN(month_start) as first_month
  FROM with_monthly
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
-- Exclude first month
excluded AS (
  SELECT mm.customer_id, mm.txn_date, mm.clamped_avg, mm.month_start
  FROM with_monthly mm
  JOIN first_months fm ON mm.customer_id = fm.customer_id AND mm.month_start != fm.first_month
),
-- Max per customer per month
max_per_customer_month AS (
  SELECT month_start, customer_id, MAX(clamped_avg) as max_avg
  FROM excluded
  GROUP BY month_start, customer_id
),
-- Sum across customers per month
monthly_totals AS (
  SELECT month_start, SUM(max_avg) as total_max_avg
  FROM max_per_customer_month
  GROUP BY month_start
  ORDER BY month_start
)
